bundle.shortDescription: One dashboard for every Google Drive account
bundle.longDescription: 9Drive Desktop turns one or more Google Drive accounts into a single storage dashboard: combined quota, uploads routed to the account with room, virtual folders, preview, download and incremental sync of the 9drive folder. Everything is local — there is no server and no 9Drive account.
